answer_1.quote: Beyond natural language understanding tasks, our study expanded to include experiments on natural language generation tasks. These experiments were conducted using the GPT-2 medium (355M) and large (774M) models on the E2E NLG Challenge.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include generated responses in natural language generation tasks such as instruction following, dialogue, and text generation.

answer_2.quote: Following previous studies, we used the official evaluation script to compute BLEU, NIST, METEOR, ROUGE-L and CIDEr scores.

answer_3.quote: Table 4: Win rates against reference responses evaluated by GPT-4 on AlpacaEval. Higher win rates indicate superior generated responses, reflecting better alignment with human preferences.
